operator_io_quirks: Huge tables: projects 664k, donations 3.1M, resources 3.7M rows; read_schema must rowid-sample (max_rows_per_table) and never copy rows into units.
essays has NO primary key and NO FK declared, yet its projectid values match projects.projectid (implicit join key); TS treats it as a free String column.
projects.projectid is declared TEXT PK but distinct=200000 < rows=664098: PK is NOT unique in the original data (duplicate projectids exist).
donations.donationid / resources.resourceid declared TEXT PK, distinct=200000 < rows: same non-unique-PK situation; sample_fresh_primary_keys will drop many rows.
FKs: donations.projectid -> projects.projectid and resources.projectid -> projects.projectid, both parent_exists=true, but parent is non-unique so FK fill draws from a filtered parent column.

date_posted declared DATE, storage text, format 'YYYY-MM-DD' (e.g. 2014-05-12); ts_fuzzer dispatch = Date|Number(int elements) because first element parses as int? (it does not; expect Date with %Y-%m-%d template).
donation_timestamp declared DATETIME, storage text, format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.mmm' (millisecond suffix); Date template set has no %f, so parsed template likely %Y-%m-%d and time part is lost/odd.
school_zip declared INTEGER but values are 5-digit zips (93662); Number fuzzer will produce ints in [-10^scale,10^scale] unrelated to zip semantics.
school_latitude/longitude REAL with negative longitudes; Number fuzzer range is symmetric so sign is fine but magnitude (e.g. 1e4) is implausible.

Many TEXT columns are boolean-like 't'/'f' (school_charter, school_magnet, is_teacher_acct, eligible_*_match, payment_included_*, via_giving_page, for_honoree, ...): declared TEXT so String fuzzer, not Bool.
dollar_amount TEXT with values 'under_10','10_to_100','100_and_up' (underscore enum); String fuzzer will not reproduce these tokens unless in literal pool.
fulfillment_labor_materials REAL has distinct=1 (constant 30.0); Number fuzzer will scatter it, breaking any equality/aggregate assumption.

High null rates: donor_zip 0.555, donor_city 0.479, secondary_focus_* 0.318, donation_message 0.258, donor_state 0.196, school_metro 0.132; TS does not enforce NOT NULL so nulls appear only via sampler dropout.
teacher_prefix includes empty string '' as a value; String fuzzer treats '' as an element and may perturb it.
essays.title/short_description/essay are long free text (truncated in samples); String fuzzer length range from min/max element length can be large.
operator_ts_expectations: String fuzzer for all TEXT columns: random a-zA-Z0-9() strings of length in [min,max] of sampled elements, plus 50% contaminate (prefix/suffix/drop char) -> implausible names, cities, states, enum tokens.
Date fuzzer for date_posted with template %Y-%m-%d (first parsable element), range from min/max parsed dates (~2014); fresh dates uniform in that range, so dates cluster in 2014 only.
Date fuzzer for donation_timestamp: template likely %Y-%m-%d (no %f in template set), so generated timestamps lose the millisecond part and may not match original format exactly.

Number fuzzer for school_zip, students_reached, vendorid, item_quantity, school_latitude/longitude, all REAL money columns: uniform in [-10^scale,10^scale] (scale from type args, default 0 for INTEGER -> [-1,1] then perturbed +-1/+-2), so zips become tiny ints and money becomes huge/negative.
Number fuzzer for REAL money columns: scale=0 default (no (a,b) args in DDL) -> range [-1,1], perturbed by +-0.01/+-0.02, so donation_total etc. become ~0 values, not 10-1000.

String fuzzer for boolean-like 't'/'f' TEXT columns: elements are 't','f' so sampler mostly returns 't'/'f' with 50% contaminate -> occasional 'tX'/'fY' garbage; misses on WHERE col='t' still mostly hit.
String fuzzer for dollar_amount: elements 'under_10','10_to_100','100_and_up' -> sampler returns these plus contaminate; equality predicates on these tokens mostly hit.
String fuzzer for school_state (51 distinct 2-letter codes): elements are 2-char strings, length range [2,3], so generated states are 2-3 random chars, not real state codes -> FN on state filters.
String fuzzer for school_metro (3 values urban/rural/suburban): elements length 5-8, sampler returns them with contaminate; equality mostly hits, LIKE '%urban%' may miss.

FK fill: donations.projectid and resources.projectid draw from projects.projectid AFTER PK dedup (200k distinct), so FK values are valid but only 200k of 664k original projectids appear; essays.projectid is NOT an FK so it gets random strings unrelated to projects -> joins essays-projects return 0 rows (FN).

PK dedup on projects/donations/resources drops ~70% of rows (distinct 200k vs rows 664k/3.1M/3.7M), so table sizes shrink drastically vs choose_table_sizes target; joins still work but cardinalities differ.
essays has no PK so no dedup; its projectid is random String -> any query joining essays to projects on projectid returns empty (FN).
fulfillment_labor_materials constant 30.0 in original; Number fuzzer scatters it -> queries filtering on that value (if any) miss (FN).

High-null columns (donor_zip 0.555, donor_city 0.479): TS does not enforce null rate, so nulls appear only via 10% element dropout and p-fresh draws; IS NULL / IS NOT NULL predicates may flip (FP/FN).

String fuzzer for long text (essay, short_description, need_statement): length range from min/max element length (up to ~40 chars in samples) -> generated text is short random strings, so LIKE '%keyword%' predicates miss (FN).
